name: What is the typical timeline for an international property purchase in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for an international property purchase in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for an international property purchase in Florida can range from 30 to 90 days, depending on financing and due diligence. Cash purchases tend to close faster, within 30-45 days, while financed transactions with foreign national loans may take 45-90 days due to additional underwriting requirements. Having all financial documents prepared and engaging a local agent who understands the process can help streamline the timeline.
